name: Sayyar Abu al-Hakam
nameAr: سيار بن أبي سيار (واسمه وردان) العنزي، أبو الحكم الواسطي

nisbas.en: al-Anazi (of Anazah ibn Asad ibn Rabi'ah; with nun and zay)

orthography.spelled: Sayyar: sin, then a doubled ya', then ra' (Ibn Hajar, Fath 1/436); al-Anazi with nun and zay (Taqrib). His father is known as Abu Sayyar; his name was Wardan, or Ward, or otherwise.
homographs: Sayyar Abu Hamzah al-Kufi, the one who actually narrates from Tariq ibn Shihab (Taqrib 2719)
Sayyar the Syrian Successor who narrates from Abu Umamah (Fath 1/436)

taqrib.ar: ثقة، وليس هو الذي يروي عن طارق ابن شهاب
taqrib.en: Reliable; and he is not the one who narrates from Tariq ibn Shihab.

teachers.name: Abu Burdah ibn Abi Musa al-Ash'ari

verdicts.ar: صدوق ثقة ثبت في كل المشايخ
verdicts.en: Truthful, reliable, firm with every one of his shaykhs.
verdicts.source: Tahdhib al-Kamal 12/313; al-Jarh wa al-Ta'dil 4/254 ("truthful, reliable")

verdicts.en: Listed him in al-Thiqat and used him in his Sahih.

verdicts.ar: اتفقوا على توثيق سيار، وأخرج له الأئمة الستة وغيرهم، وقد أدرك بعض الصحابة لكن لم يلق أحدا منهم فهو من كبار أتباع التابعين
verdicts.en: They agree on Sayyar's reliability and all six imams used him; he lived in the time of some Companions but met none, so he is of the senior men of the generation after the Successors.

flags.label: Homonym: Sayyar Abu Hamzah
flags.detail: A report "Sayyar Abu al-Hakam from Tariq ibn Shihab" is an error for Sayyar Abu Hamzah al-Kufi; Ahmad, Ibn Ma'in and al-Daraqutni say Abu al-Hakam never narrated from Tariq, and al-Daraqutni counts al-Bukhari's statement that he heard Tariq among his slips (Tahdhib al-Tahdhib 2/142; Taqrib 2718–2719).

flags.label: Homonym: the Syrian Sayyar
flags.detail: Ibn Hajar warns that another Sayyar, a Syrian Successor used by al-Tirmidhi, narrates the meaning of this very hadith from Abu Umamah, and since neither is given a nisba in the chains a careless reader might take them for one man (Fath 1/436).

flags.label: Ahmad on Hushaym's hearing
flags.detail: Ahmad ibn Hanbal is reported to have said Hushaym did not hear from Sayyar (Tahdhib al-Tahdhib 4/280). The Sahihs record Hushaym saying "Sayyar informed us" and "narrated to us"; see the Hushaym record.

bio: A reliable Wasiti of the generation after the Successors, used by all six compilers, and the half-brother of Musawir al-Warraq. He is the link between Yazid al-Faqir and Hushaym in the hadith of the five gifts, and al-Bukhari names him once by his kunya alone ("Sayyar, that is Abu al-Hakam", hadith 438). Two other men called Sayyar shadow him in the books: Abu Hamzah, the real narrator from Tariq ibn Shihab, and a Syrian Successor who carries a parallel of this hadith; Ibn Hajar flags both.

provenance.ref: Tahdhib al-Tahdhib 2/142 and al-Jarh wa al-Ta'dil 4/254, as collected on the Shamela narrator record 2717

sources.label: Ibn Hajar, Fath al-Bari 1/436 on hadith 335 (Shamela)
